proxy.traefik:
# Traefik reference config for jackett, generated by the hub from its image.yml.
# Labels for the jackett service in your compose file. Traefik's docker provider must reach the jackett
# container on a shared network; the entrypoint websecure and the certificate resolver letsencrypt are
# examples from a typical Traefik setup. Replace example.com with your domain. Websockets need nothing extra.
services:
  jackett:
    labels:
      - traefik.enable=true
      - traefik.http.services.jackett.loadbalancer.server.port=9117
      - traefik.http.routers.jackett.rule=Host(`jackett.example.com`)
      - traefik.http.routers.jackett.entrypoints=websecure
      - traefik.http.routers.jackett.tls.certresolver=letsencrypt
      - traefik.http.routers.jackett.service=jackett
      # Authentication: uncomment one; the middleware is defined in your Traefik config.
      # - traefik.http.routers.jackett.middlewares=authelia@docker
      # - traefik.http.routers.jackett.middlewares=authentik@docker
      # API paths stay open so client applications keep working.
      - traefik.http.routers.jackett-api.rule=Host(`jackett.example.com`) && (PathPrefix(`/api`) || PathPrefix(`/dl`))
      - traefik.http.routers.jackett-api.entrypoints=websecure
      - traefik.http.routers.jackett-api.tls.certresolver=letsencrypt
      - traefik.http.routers.jackett-api.service=jackett
      - traefik.http.routers.jackett-api.priority=100

kubernetes:
# Jackett: generated by the hub from https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-jackett/blob/master/image.yml
# Storage sizes are placeholders; secrets belong in a Secret, not this ConfigMap.
# Security notes:
#   - readOnlyRootFilesystem is supported by this image; enable it once /config and /tmp are mounted.
#   - runAsNonRoot is supported by this image (set runAsUser and drop PUID/PGID).
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: jackett-env
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: jackett
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
data:
  PUID: '1000'
  PGID: '1000'
  TZ: Etc/UTC
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: jackett-config
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: jackett
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: jackett-downloads
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: jackett
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: jackett
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: jackett
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: jackett
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: jackett
        app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: jackett
        image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/jackett:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef:
            name: jackett-env
        ports:
        - name: port-9117
          containerPort: 9117
          protocol: TCP
        volumeMounts:
        - name: jackett-config
          mountPath: /config
        - name: jackett-downloads
          mountPath: /downloads
      volumes:
      - name: jackett-config
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: jackett-config
      - name: jackett-downloads
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: jackett-downloads
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: jackett
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: jackett
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: jackett
  ports:
  - name: port-9117
    port: 9117
    targetPort: 9117
    protocol: TCP
quadlet:
# jackett.container: generated by the hub from https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-jackett/blob/master/image.yml
# Optional parameters are commented out.

[Unit]
Description=Jackett (LinuxServer.io)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Container]
Image=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/jackett:latest
ContainerName=jackett
AutoUpdate=registry
Environment=PUID=1000
Environment=PGID=1000
Environment=TZ=Etc/UTC
# Environment=AUTO_UPDATE=true
# Environment=RUN_OPTS=
Volume=/path/to/jackett/data:/config:Z
Volume=/path/to/blackhole:/downloads:Z
PublishPort=9117:9117

[Service]
Restart=always
TimeoutStartSec=900

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
